title: steelco
description: Steelco is an Italian medical device company founded in 2001, specializing in cleaning, disinfection, and sterilization equipment for hospitals, laboratories, and the pharmaceutical industry; it joined Germany's Miele Group in 2017 and merged with Switzerland's Belimed in 2024 to form SteelcoBelimed AG, now generating approximately €479 million in annual revenue and exporting to over 100 countries
